column6: eval () => {   const resultsText = document.querySelector('.form-horizontal strong')?.innerText;   const books = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.product_pod')).map(pod => {     const title = pod.querySelector('h3 a').getAttribute('title');     const price = pod.querySelector('.price_color').innerText;     return { title, price };   });   return { resultsText, books }; }
